name: Beijing E-Town Semiconductor Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing E-Town Semiconductor Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, manufacturing, and sale of wafer processing equipment used in integrated circuit processing in China, the United States, and Germany. The company provides integrated circuit manufacturing equipment and support processing solutions, including dry etching and plasma surface treatment equipment, and rapid thermal processing equipment. The company also provides spare parts, equipment upgrades, and maintenance services.
